When the page is first painted and the pointer is elsewhere, the browser reports `root>cta`'s `getComputedStyle()` with `background-color: rgb(51, 85, 255)`. The hover state changes this to `rgb(0, 34, 204)`, confirming the non-hover value is the initial one. The hex equivalent of rgb(51, 85, 255) is #3555FF.

ANSWER: rgb(51, 85, 255) (#3555FF)
